command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: DeepSeek incorrectly says stock ipmitool cannot express the request; Master provides `raw 0x04 0x27 <Sensor number>`. The source OOB form is unsafe only because it exposes the password and lacks host-verification guidance.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Run protected `ipmitool raw 0x04 0x27 <sensor-number>` in-band; if Project SPEC retains the source comparison, issue the same raw request over a credential-safe verified OOB interface without command-line passwords.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Sensor number remains a required source parameter; both original paths, criteria and 10/5 timing are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Bind the query to one SDR sensor, parse the readable mask before the six raw values, convert with authoritative units and compare only supported fields across required paths.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Corrects unsafe secret handling and ambiguous byte-numbering in the Review layer without changing Master.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A high-level `sensor list` comparison is supplemental and may round values. OOB evidence does not replace original in-band coverage, and in-band alone leaves the explicit OOB checkpoint uncovered when retained.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Mask/index/unit mistakes can report unsupported bytes as thresholds or hide unsafe limits; high-level output may round or omit raw values.

project_override_considerations: Alternate APIs are acceptable for comparison only when sensor identity, readable mask, raw values and conversion are traceable. Each omitted IB/OOB path must be recorded as unverified coverage.
expected_evidence: Protected in-band raw request/response and completion
OOB raw evidence if required with secret-safe transport metadata
Readable mask and all six raw threshold fields

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The IB title includes an additional OOB command, unsafe plaintext password syntax and an ambiguous byte 3-8 description; Criteria assumes high-level equality without mask/unit/rounding rules. DeepSeek also misstates executability. Review preserves source while separating paths and correcting acceptance guidance.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The read operation and both transport paths are identifiable. Sensor identity, response indexing, expected vector and OOB scope are project inputs; all execution can remain read-only and fail closed.

review_improvement: Restores direct raw executability, protects OOB credentials, makes threshold-mask/index/unit handling explicit and prevents unsupported or rounded fields from creating false mismatches.
independent_technical_reasoning: The response's readable mask determines which threshold bytes carry valid data, while `sensor list` may convert and round them. Therefore correctness requires raw-field parsing and SDR-based conversion before any cross-interface comparison. The bounded read is automatable; the source's second transport is tracked separately rather than silently discarded.
